notes:
Closing a tab now works on the first tap.

Tapping the × on a tab often took two or three goes. The tab strip was treating the tap as the start of a sideways scroll and swallowing it. Selecting a tab was fixed for the same reason a while back; closing one never was, which is why it has been like this for so long. The × is also a little wider now, though the tabs are no taller.

This update also records more detail in its own logs when two paired tablets exchange annotations, so a reported problem with writing made on the second tablet can be tracked down. Nothing about how the app behaves changes.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
